functional_duplicates.rationale: Both fields carry the user's free-form WhatsApp message text — WF-30, WF-44, and WF-23 pass it as messageText while WF-40 passes it as messageContent, yet WF-25's static code unconditionally destructures messageContent, causing messageText callers to supply an undefined value to the Gemini prompt.

subagent_notes: WF-31 and WF-43 use passthrough mode so their input fields are not enumerated — they are excluded from dead_pass and caller_missing_required analysis per schema rules. The caller_missing_required entry for messageContent is not passed_by_none (WF-40 does pass it) but WF-30, WF-44, and WF-23 pass messageText instead, which is the functional_duplicate; this is the core latent bug confirmed by both static code and execution data (exec 1639 shows messageContent present from WF-40). Runtime exec 1639 confirms userId is a number (28) at runtime though pseudo declares no type. Output delta is additions_only because geminiError, geminiPrompt, and geminiBody are added to return payload but not in existing pseudo Outputs section.
